title: Tuning emissive color of trivalent terbium ion through environmental factors: optoelectronic insights from theoretical, spectral and computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39569-39587
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05334F, Paper

Vandana Aggarwal, Devender Singh, Shri Bhagwan, Raman Kumar Saini, Komal Jakhar, Sumit Kumar, Parvin Kumar, Jayant Sindhu
The combination of 4,4,4-trifluoro-1-phenyl-1,3-butanedione (TFPB) and pyrazine (pyz) with Tb3+ ions forms two distinct types of complexes, represented by the formulas [Tb(TFPB)3(L)2], where L is either H2O or pyz, and [(Tb(TFPB)3)2pyz].
